description: This file defines the Surveys class, which models the 'surveys' module in a SuiteCRM-based application. It includes properties for survey attributes and methods for saving surveys and their questions/options, as well as utility functions such as retrieving matrix options and submit button text.

classes.name: Surveys
classes.description: A class representing the Surveys module, extending Basic. It manages survey data, related questions, options, and utility functions.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the object implements a given interface; specifically supports 'ACL'.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the survey and associated questions and options based on request data.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Saves the options for a given survey question.

methods.name: getMatrixOptions
methods.description: Returns an array of matrix options, with default fallback texts.

methods.name: getSubmitText
methods.description: Returns the submit button text, defaulting to 'Submit' if not set.
